segment.source: Raised when the effective column assignment of children changes, dispatched after the layout pass.
Basic usage. Set the number of columns with ColumnCount and the spacing with ColumnGap and RowGap.
Demonstrate dynamic item updates and explicit Masonry.Column assignments.
With StableColumns, images update size and vertical positions as they load without moving existing items between columns.
Masonry uses stable column assignments by default and can opt into classic shortest-column reflow, with fixed or adaptive column counts and row/column gaps.
Lay out children of unequal heights into stable or reflowing columns.
Use responsive values to adapt to different screen widths. ColumnInfo controls the column count at each breakpoint, and Gutter controls the spacing.
Item container measured, column-assigned and arranged by the masonry layout, carrying the Masonry.Column and Masonry.Span metadata.
Use owner-scoped styles and the MasonryItemStyle semantic part style to customize Masonry's published Semantic Parts.
Root element, provides the root chrome, column and gutter layout inputs, and the ItemsControl entry.
